avis.texte: Je connais très bien ce produit que je ne trouve plus en parapharmacie. Intolérante à presque tout celui ci hydrate à la perfection !!!

The first time I used this mask as a treatment, I wasn’t entirely blown away. No problems, but it didn’t really seem to be a standout product either. Then I left it on overnight—same thing. But then (weeks later and several days apart) I tried it a couple times after more aggressive treatments—for instance after a Glamglow thirsty mud mask or after The Ordinary’s peeling treatment—and holy cow!!! The combination of having done a pore-clearing or peeling treatment with this is just phenomenal! It’s the perfect thing to soothe the skin if I’d done a resurfacing treatment, and the perfect thing to hydrate the skin well after I’d cleaned out the pores—without reclogging them!! I put this under my eyes and everywhere, using about a tablespoon. What a value. The tube will last quite a while, and I think the price is very fair. I will always keep this around! Update: It is also wonderful to use after a sheet mask. I can put this on to seal in all the serumy goodness and know that the ingredients won’t interfere. Went to bed with a red spot, and after my sheet mask and this, woke up to clear, smooth skin. Totally sinks in—just give it a bit of time.
